name: Siemens Aktiengesellschaft
blurb: Siemens AG is a German multinational industrial technology conglomerate and one of the most heavily weighted constituents of the DAX40. The company operates across industrial automation, digitalization, electrification, smart infrastructure, and mobility. Headquartered in Munich, it serves customers in manufacturing, energy, transportation, and building technology worldwide. Siemens has a structured investor-relations presence including a defined equity story, ongoing share buyback programs, and regular bond issuances.
recent: Siemens released its Q1 FY2026 results on February 12, 2026, and the company's investor-relations page currently features Q2 FY2026 materials as the lead item, indicating quarterly results were recently published around May 2026. A share buyback program announced November 2023 has been running since February 12, 2024.
